scripts.build: mkdir -p public && echo 'Initial public dir created' && pnpm -r --if-present run build && echo 'pnpm -r build done' && pnpm --filter @workspace/pdf-tools build && echo 'Explicit filter build done' && (cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/dist/public/. public/ || cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/dist/. public/ || cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/public/. public/ || true) && echo 'Copy done' && ls -la public/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
